issues.key: send-track:leads.json truncated on origin/data by commit 015cf9d (research: L0093)
issues.title: leads.json truncated on origin/data by commit 015cf9d (research: L0093)
issues.detail: At 14:13:44 on 2026-11-13 commit 015cf9d (research: L0093, from a concurrent lead-scout session) rewrote data/leads.json with 7 insertions and 6608 deletions; the file now stops mid-record around line 19601 (a Stitch Product Manager lead, cut after "exp_min") and no longer parses. It is already on origin/data. The previous commit c9891c2 (research: L0092) parses fine. Likely cause: two processes (send-track and lead-scout/scout) wrote leads.json at the same moment while store.sync ran git reset --hard. Every lead command now fails with 'Expecting : delimiter'. Fix: restore leads.json from c9891c2 and re-apply the L0093 research, then add a file lock around store.transact so concurrent agents cannot interleave. send-track stopped writing to leads once this was found.
issues.remedy: Fixed 2026-11-13: leads.json restored from c9891c2 plus the surviving L0029 note; the 11 lost research results re-applied from pending-research. store.transact now holds a cross-process lock, save() uses a unique temp file, git calls time out, and a file that does not parse is never committed.

issues.key: lead-scout:leads.json corrupted on data branch by concurrent write (commit 015cf9d)
issues.title: leads.json corrupted on data branch by concurrent write (commit 015cf9d)
issues.detail: Commit 015cf9d 'research: L0093' (2026-11-13 14:13) truncated leads.json to invalid JSON (7 insertions, 6608 deletions; parse error line 19601 col 13). Cause: lead-scout ran 'outreach scout' in the background while running 'lead research' in the foreground; store.save() writes every process to the same leads.json.tmp path, so the two writes interleaved and transact() committed and pushed the mangled file. Last good commit: c9891c2. Fix: 'git -C data revert 015cf9d && git push origin HEAD:data' (my revert was blocked by the permission classifier), then re-run research for L0093-L0128 from the saved JSON in the run notes. Code fix: give save() a unique temp name (e.g. tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile in DATA_DIR) and validate JSON before commit; also a hung 'git fetch' from 13:17 (pid 62733, another session) and 'cannot lock ref' races when two CLI calls sync at once. Separately: 'lead research' auto-rejected L0090 (AiSteth) with 'score 64 is under 65' although decision was qualify.
issues.remedy: Fixed 2026-11-13: leads.json restored from c9891c2 plus the surviving L0029 note; the 11 lost research results re-applied from pending-research. store.transact now holds a cross-process lock, save() uses a unique temp file, git calls time out, and a file that does not parse is never committed.

issues.key: supervisor:GitHub scheduled workflows run hours late or are dropped
issues.title: GitHub scheduled workflows run hours late or are dropped
issues.detail: Seen again 15 Nov (gh run list at 20:10 IST, UTC slots so far): Track and send (cron 50 2-14) ran once of 12 slots, at 09:58 UTC; Lead scout (40 1,6,11) ran once of 3, at 08:26 UTC; Morning digest (03:00) ran 10:14 UTC, 7 h late; Live check (00:10) ran 06:18 UTC, 6 h late; Supervisor checks (15 3,9) ran once, 11:01 UTC; Research and write (30 0,4,8,12) has never run on schedule, only by hand. follow-up/track last ok 15:28 IST, 4.7 h ago (limit 4 h).
issues.remedy: Cause: GitHub Actions cron on a free account is best-effort; under load it delays or skips scheduled runs, worst on a new repo with little activity. Remedy (for Shlok to choose): trigger the workflows from an external scheduler (e.g. a cron-job.org call or the Mac's launchd running 'gh workflow run'), or move the digest cron earlier so a late run still lands in the morning. Until then, after approving emails press Run workflow on 'Track and send' to send them right away.

issues.key: send-track:git fetch of data branch hangs for hours
issues.title: git fetch of data branch hangs for hours
issues.detail: On 2026-11-14 several 'git -C data fetch origin data' calls (from store.sync) hung for 2+ hours with no timeout, while github.com answered normally. One hung fetch held the store lock and blocked every write until the process was killed. store._git passes timeout=180 but child git-remote-https processes outlived it; consider GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT/TIME env and killing the process group on timeout. Also seen once: 'git reset --hard origin/data' exit 128 while another session was syncing.
issues.remedy: Fixed in 6ebb3bd: git now runs in its own process group that is killed on timeout along with git-remote-https; a stalled connection gives up after 30 s; fetch and push fail after 90 s with a clear 'no answer from GitHub' error instead of holding the store lock. Inside a sandboxed shell with no network the commands now fail in 90 s; run them outside the sandbox.

issues.key: lead-scout:outreach commands hang on git fetch inside the Claude Code sandbox
issues.title: outreach commands hang on git fetch inside the Claude Code sandbox
issues.detail: 2026-11-14 scheduled lead-scout: every python3 -m outreach call hung indefinitely at 'git -C data fetch origin data' when run in the sandboxed shell (store.sync, no timeout reached in 30+ min; leftover git-remote-https processes from another session at 11:55 were also stuck). Same fetch completed in ~1s with the sandbox disabled. Run continued unsandboxed. Fix idea: add github.com to the sandbox network allowlist for this project, or make _git fetch fail fast with a short timeout and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0.

issues.key: supervisor:Application packet deployment blocked by Vercel build limit
issues.title: Application packet deployment blocked by Vercel build limit
issues.detail: PR 3 builds locally but Vercel rejected its preview with Deployment rate limited — retry in 24 hours. No paid upgrade authorized. Retry deployment after provider limit resets and verify packet before calling it live.
issues.remedy: Cause: Vercel's free (Hobby) plan limits how many deployments a project can make per day; today's many pushes (PR 1, PR 3, PR 4 merges plus previews) used it up, so PR 3's preview was refused with 'Deployment rate limited, retry in 24 hours'. The live site still answers (outreach-hq-psi.vercel.app/login returned 200 at 20:11 IST) but runs the older build without the packet page. Remedy: after about 15:45 IST on 2026-11-15, redeploy main once from the Vercel dashboard (Deployments > Redeploy) or push one commit, then open the packet page to confirm before resolving. Batch site changes into fewer pushes to stay under the limit; no paid upgrade needed.
